description: The image smoke browser selection (scripts/smoke-image.sh): --project=production-chromium production.neutral production.csp. Every case below must be discovered once and pass once with no retry (scripts/lib/playwright-cases.mjs). A legitimate change to these specs updates this list in the same commit; the check is never relaxed to match.
cases: production-chromium › production.csp.spec.ts › content security policy (B10, production build) › the neutral app raises zero violations, and the compatibility screen too
production-chromium › production.neutral.spec.ts › neutral shell › shows the sign-in surface and nothing about any account, and the protected root stays inert, hidden and empty (B6)
production-chromium › production.neutral.spec.ts › neutral shell › the production build carries no fixture entry or marker
production-chromium › production.neutral.spec.ts › neutral shell › a fragment this client does not recognise is left alone through boot (B11)
production-chromium › production.neutral.spec.ts › neutral shell › a recognised fragment (the OIDC grant) is stripped at boot, valid or not, and the page says it wasn't valid
production-chromium › production.neutral.spec.ts › neutral shell › does not rewrite history on load
production-chromium › production.neutral.spec.ts › neutral shell › a deep link is served the shell, then the sign-in surface, without touching the path
production-chromium › production.neutral.spec.ts › neutral shell › has no axe violations, including rendered contrast (dark)
production-chromium › production.neutral.spec.ts › neutral shell › has no axe violations, including rendered contrast (light)
